scope: P02-T02 descriptor-backed protected process staging/start/stop/reap; no NATS readiness or detached lifecycle integration.

environment.fixtureBuild: Static CGO-disabled Go helper executed; separate CGO-enabled dynamic helper built only for rejection, never executed.

repairs.finding: Source-buffer hash did not bind actual memfd bytes if changed before seal.
repairs.repair: Seal and verify kernel seals first, then re-read/hash immutable descriptor against trusted digest, then ELF-check immutable bytes.
repairs.actualNegative: TestChangedMemfdBeforeSealIsRejected alters a real memfd after approved source copy, then calls same sealAndVerify path. Refusal occurs after F_GET_SEALS proves write seal.

repairs.repair: Initial protected foundation rejects PT_INTERP/DT_NEEDED; static Go fixture CGO disabled.
repairs.actualNegative: Real native CGO ELF has interpreter and needed library; original denied; variant replaces only PT_INTERP header with PT_NULL and is denied by DT_NEEDED. Neither dynamic image executed.

actualProcessChecks: Four distinct actual fixture PIDs, literal special-character arguments and isolated explicit environment.
TERM-to-KILL escalation, wait-based exit state, idempotent Stop and unrelated sentinel survives.
Parent cancellation after start, canceled-before-start and cancellation during partial startup all reap owned children.
Partial Start failure cleans earlier child; no caller PID adoption or process-group kill API.
Concurrent Stop honors waiting caller deadline without preventing first owner from reaping.
Prepared image survives original source replacement and seal denies write even after same owner restores write permission bit.
Actual immediate exit status and bounded/truncated child output observed.
ownership: Only platform/runtime source/tests/README and this evidence written. Initial approved platform module pins unchanged.
No global tracker/manifest/pattern attestation, launcher/Compose, P01 schema, legacy runtime or Docker change.
No model/provider or business-state process launched; only compiled disposable fixture children.
historicalEvidence: Earlier full runs and observer test failure retained. The old source-buffer-only snapshots are preserved externally at before-sealed-rehash/source-hashes.json and runtime/; they do not establish current staging security. Earlier seal test EACCES was a test setup issue, fixed by restoring owner write permission then observing kernel EPERM.

darwin.requiredNext: Actual native macOS CI run of unlinked descriptor probe, including RO write/reopened writer and actual child execution; review immutable-object strategy and implement qualified Darwin backend. Mandatory native macOS boot/Compose acceptance remains unchanged. Successful probe alone is not same-UID immutability proof.

limits: Not a sandbox for same-UID trusted plugins or privileged debuggers; package checksums do not enroll authority.
OS syscall stalls cannot be guaranteed interruptible at an exact wall-clock deadline. Local regular-file size/context checks and descriptor starts have explicit lifecycle budgets.
Processes are started, not application-ready. NATS role/account/readiness and healthy detachment integration remain required.
Only directly created children are owned. Trusted protected roles must not daemonize or create unmanaged descendants; no unknown process-group kill is used.
Static protected Go policy does not restrict ordinary language-neutral P03 plugins.
Native macOS/Linux host qualification and phase gate remain separate; this execution is actual WSL Linux.
